description: Repair volatile Runtime Event Queue receipt evidence ownership so each bounded waiter interval starts clean and late retryable deliveries cannot recreate ownerless evidence.

tasks.title: Make receipt evidence lifecycle interval-owned
tasks.description: Adjust only the existing Runtime Event Queue bounded receipt-wait seam so evidence is created, updated, and discarded with an active bounded waiter interval. Preserve queue records, delivery leases, retry scheduling, FIFO ordering, matching identity, and definitive refusal semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: A new bounded waiter starts with zero attempts, zero derived retries, and no prior latest reason after the previous interval ended.
Coalesced bounded waiters share one active interval and its outcome.
A late retryable delivery with no active bounded waiter retains the queue record and existing retry path without creating evidence.
A late retryable verdict from an old delivery cannot update a later interval's evidence.
Timeout evidence still contains the interval's record id, elapsed time, budget, attempts, retries, and latest normalized reason.
Matching late settlement, permanent refusal, delivery leases, retry timing, FIFO ordering, and unrelated records retain current behavior.
No persistence, Outbox, journal, snapshot, receipt store, second queue, Server/API/schema, or runtime protocol change is introduced.
tasks.output: Interval-owned volatile receipt evidence in the existing Runtime Event Queue.
tasks.notes: Future implementation task. Spec artifact validation for this change is complete in the design-first PR.

tasks.title: Add deterministic late-delivery interval regression coverage
tasks.description: Extend the existing Runner queue tests with fake-time deferred deliveries for timeout-to-late-retry-to-new-waiter, cancellation-to-late-retry-to-matching-settlement, coalesced waiters, and retained unrelated records.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests use Vitest fake timers and the injected queue clock; they contain no sleeps, polling assertions, or wall-clock deadline assertions.
Timeout-to-late-retry-to-new-waiter proves old attempts and reasons are absent from the later timeout evidence.
Cancellation-to-late-retry-to-matching-settlement proves only the waiter ends while normal record acknowledgement remains possible.
Existing matching, permanent refusal, retry, lease, FIFO, capacity, coalescing, and unbounded-wait regressions remain green.
Focused Runner queue/action tests, `npm run docs:check`, `npm run archtest`, `npm run test:fast`, and `npm run verify` pass.
tasks.output: Deterministic evidence-interval regression coverage and verification output.
tasks.notes: Future implementation task. Spec artifact validation for this change is complete in the design-first PR.
